text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day after Grass Wonder's day off, I head over to my office only to find…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh! I-I'm sorry. I only meant to take a quick rest on the sofa.
choice_data_list: Did you get enough sleep yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, I sort of lost track of time while gazing at my moss terrarium last night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There is an art to growing moss in a glass tank, and it brings me joy to observe its daily progress.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I need to take care not to let it cut into my sleep schedule… Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Grass Wonder stayed up late rather than get a proper night's rest.
